mapper.select: SELECT d.*, dep.name as department_name FROM division d LEFT JOIN department dep ON d.department_id = dep.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT d.*, dep.name as department_name FROM division d LEFT JOIN department dep ON d.department_id = dep.id ORDER BY d.update_time DESC
SELECT d.*, dep.name as department_name FROM division d LEFT JOIN department dep ON d.department_id = dep.id WHERE d.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY d.update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO division(name, department_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{name}, #{departmentId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM teacher_users t INNER JOIN class c ON t.teacher_user_id = c.teacher_user_id INNER JOIN major m ON c.major_id = m.id WHERE m.division_id = #{divisionId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM student_users s INNER JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id WHERE m.division_id = #{divisionId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) FROM student_internship_status sis INNER JOIN student_users su ON sis.student_id = su.id INNER JOIN major m ON su.major_id = m.id WHERE m.division_id = #{divisionId} AND sis.status = 2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) FROM student_users su INNER JOIN major m ON su.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN student_internship_status sis ON su.id = sis.student_id WHERE m.division_id = #{divisionId} AND (sis.status = 0 OR sis.status IS NULL)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT su.id) FROM student_internship_status sis INNER JOIN student_users su ON sis.student_id = su.id INNER JOIN major m ON su.major_id = m.id WHERE m.division_id = #{divisionId} AND sis.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE division SET confirmed_count = #{confirmedCount}, not_found_count = #{notFoundCount}, has_offer_count = #{hasOfferCount}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
